verdicts.reason: In A the product bottle, the original's centrepiece, is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the top-right corner on top of a decorative circle. The oversized headline nearly touches the bottom edge, the legal text is almost as large as the subcopy, and the ribbon floats on its own between the two columns. B keeps the left-to-right flow (copy, then the bottle at a sensible size, then the CTA), but the ribbon is crammed between the tiny logo and the headline with almost no gap. The CTA also floats at the right edge, cut off from its copy, and leaves a dead band above the legal line.
